rules.content:
/*
ramp ransomware
*/

rule ramp_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.ramp"
        description = "Detects ramp ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "ramp" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "RAMP" ascii
        $onion  = "ramp.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
